The basics

Meet Ace.

Ace was born November 25, 2025. He is currently 10 months old and is already very confident about what belongs to him.

🐾Born
November 25, 2025
🛏️Favorite spot
Lilly's pillow
🎾Favorite activity
Dogs + naps
💗Favorite person
Lilly
Ace-approved

His favorite things.

These are the things that have survived the rigorous Ace approval process. The toys, unfortunately, have a much harder time surviving.

🦴

Toys

Ace has a very simple philosophy: if it squeaks, he wants it. If it can be destroyed, even better.

WishbonesBacon squeaky ballsTug toys
🥓

Treats

His snack standards are high. He has made his preferences very clear. He also loves pup cups — especially when Lilly is the one holding them.

Salmon & coconut jerkyMilkbonesSweet potato crispsDuck feet
🍚

Food

Fresh lamb and rice with some veggies and salmon oil. Because apparently regular dinner is not enough.

🌱

Favorite place

The dog park — or literally any patch of grass where he can roll around like he has nowhere else to be.

🐕

Favorite activity

Playing with other dogs. Runner-up: sleeping completely upside down on his back.

🛌

Favorite sleeping spot

Right on the pillow in his owner's bed. Specifically Lilly's pillow. Personal space is apparently optional.

Growing up

Ace through the years.

One birthday so far. Many toys destroyed. A lifetime of being spoiled still ahead.

November 25, 2025

Chapter 1: Ace arrives 🐶

Ace was born and officially began his journey toward becoming the household's most important resident.

Puppy era

Chapter 2: The personality develops

He discovered dogs, toys, grass, snacks, and the deeply satisfying experience of sleeping on his back.

The toy era

Chapter 3: Toys have a shelf life

Ace developed a special talent for destroying his toys. New ones are apparently required about once a month.

September 2026

Chapter 4: Professional pillow occupation

Ace has refined his most important skill: finding Lilly's pillow and making himself completely comfortable.

November 25, 2026

Chapter 5: The big ONE 🎂

Ace turns one. A very important milestone for a very spoiled dog.

Breaking news

Ace still thinks the pillow is his.

After extensive investigation, no evidence has been found that Ace plans to return it.

From Ace's journal

A few important entries.

Small moments from the life of a dog who has somehow made everything about himself.

ENTRY 001

Dear diary,

Today I rolled around in the grass. I think I looked incredible. I will be doing it again tomorrow.

ENTRY 002

Very serious update.

I found a toy. I destroyed the toy. I would like a new toy now. This is how the system works.

ENTRY 003

Bedtime negotiations.

Lilly wanted her pillow. I disagreed. I laid down first, so legally it is mine.
